title: Riding in a Self Driving Car - With Nobody Up Front | JJRicks Rides With Waymo #1
summary: JJRicks rides in Waymo's fully driverless Level 4 cars in Phoenix with nobody in the front seats, across two long rides. It is the first in a series of such ride videos.
why: HN people share it as first-hand evidence that driverless Waymo rides were already happening, including navigating a busy mall parking lot.

quote.text: Check out this video, it works really well
